presets.tagline: Versatile Flux GGUF — anime and photoreal
presets.description: GGUF Flux.1 Krea fine-tune (Cyber Supergirl). Handles anime illustration and photoreal portraits from the same model. 35 steps, euler/beta, lower VRAM than the DiT presets.

requirements.notes: GGUF quantized Flux.1 Krea. UnetLoaderGGUF + Flux dual text encoder (clip_l + T5-XXL fp8 scaled, ~5.4 GB, downloaded on install) + Flux ae VAE. euler/beta, CFG 1, negative zeroed. Lower VRAM than the FP8 Krea-2 turbo presets. LOADER SWITCH (1.2.0): ComfyUI-GGUF moved from city96 6ea2651 to molbal/ComfyUI-GGUF 48de657 together with SimpliGen's own GGUF packs. Tested 2026-10-04/05 in plain ComfyUI 0.37.2: each loader repeats itself byte for byte (3 runs each), but the two give different pictures for the same seed on this model (21-24 dB, same composition, details such as signage differ), so an old seed will not reproduce exactly after this update. Both loaders decode the file to bit-identical weights; a reference render of those weights through the stock UNETLoader matches the fork (32.2 / 28.9 dB) and not city96 (23.8 / 20.5 dB), so the new result is the faithful one.
